description.text: The Pharmacy Program aims to cultivate international students with good independent learning ability and medical value orientation, and become medical talents with profound pharmacy theory, practical skills and scientific research ability. It also lays a solid foundation for students' work in medical education, scientific research and medical career management.Fee:Tuition Fee: 20000 CNY/YEARRegistration Fee: 400 CNYHostel Fee: 5000 CNY/YEARInsurance Fee:200 CNY/YEARNingxia Government Scholarship forUndergraduate Students:For freshmen:15000 CNY/Person(Only for the first academic year)Scholarship:For seniors:1000-5000 CNY/Person(First, Second and Third Comprehensive Scholarship; Encourage Awards and Individual Award)*Application Deadline:From April 15 to seats full.

duration.text: The Pharmacy at Ningxia Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.NXMU Application Form2.Copy of passport, valid for more than six months3.Notarized copies of the highest academic certificate and transcripts and English translations4.Photo, without cap, white background without borders, size 100-500KB, JPG format;5.Physical examination form for foreigners6.No criminal record certificate7.Economic guarantee certificate8.Language level Certificate*1.The power of attorney of the guardian (notarized) shall be in duplicate and signed (provided by the applicant under the age of 18 on September i of the year when the application is submitted). The guardian shall be a Chinese or foreign adult who is a resident in China and has a stable source ofincome;2. lf needed, our university will require the applicant to submit the supplementary materials.3. The above materials will not be returnedregardless of admission or not.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants for bachelor's degree shall be no more than 25 years old. Ordinary advancedstudents shall be no more than 45 years old. Senior advanced students shall be no more than 50 years old.2. Non-Chinese citizens should hold a foreign ordinary passport with a validity period of six months or more (students under the age of 18 must present a power of attorney from parents).3.Applicants who immigrate from Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan to foreign countries must have a valid foreign passport or international certification document for more than 4 years, and have a record of having actually lived abroad for more than 2 years in the last 4 years (up to April 30 ofthe year of enrollment).4.Applicants who love medical profession, have a good character, maintain good physical and mental health, nocriminal record, and consciously abide by the Constitution, laws, and school rules and regulations of the People's Republic of China.5. Qualified with a high school degree or above or K12 grade(10+2) or equivalent academic ability; English, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology courses have passed the graduation exams of the student's country.as follows:courseEnglishAverage scores in physics, chemistry and biologygradeB/70B/70
